# Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "rpart", "randomForest", "glmnet", "xgboost")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Install these packages first: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(glmnet)
library(xgboost)
set.seed(415)
pre_color <- "#377EB8"
post_color <- "#E69F00"
phq_color <- pre_color
gad_color <- post_color
outcome_colors <- c("PHQ" = phq_color, "GAD" = gad_color)
period_colors <- c("2017-2018" = pre_color, "2022-2023" = post_color)
feature_colors <- c("Full features" = pre_color,
                    "Student characteristics only" = post_color)
paper_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
ggplot2::theme_set(paper_theme)

```

# Load Training, Testing, and Validation Data

```{r load_model_data}
project_root <- if (file.exists("data/split/training_data.csv")) {
  "."
} else if (file.exists("../data/split/training_data.csv")) {
  ".."
} else {
  stop("Cannot find data/split/training_data.csv. Open the project .Rproj first.")
}

split_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "split")
required_files <- c("training_data.csv", "test_data.csv", "validation_data.csv")
for (filename in required_files) {
  if (!file.exists(file.path(split_dir, filename))) {
    stop("Missing required data file: ", file.path(split_dir, filename))
  }
}
training_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "training_data.csv"))
testing_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "test_data.csv"))
validation_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "validation_data.csv"))

model_columns <- c("PHQ", "GAD", "gender", "field", "race.2",
                   "yr_sch.2", "fincur.2", "age")
for (dataset_name in c("training_data", "testing_data", "validation_data")) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(model_columns, names(get(dataset_name)))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(dataset_name, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

dim(training_data)
dim(testing_data)
dim(validation_data)
```

# Prepare Predictive Modeling Data

```{r model_01_prepare_predictive_modeling_data}
train <- training_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

test <- testing_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

validation <- validation_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()
```

# Set Factor Levels

```{r normalize_stem_labels}
for (dataset_name in c("train", "test", "validation")) {
  dataset <- get(dataset_name)
  dataset$field <- as.character(dataset$field)
  dataset$field[dataset$field == "NotSTEM"] <- "Non-STEM"
  assign(dataset_name, dataset)
}
```


```{r model_02_set_factor_levels}
race_levels <- c("White", "Asian", "Black", "Hispanic", "Middle Eastern")
year_levels <- c("firstyear", "secondyear", "thirdyear", "fourthyear+")

train$gender <- factor(
  train$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

test$gender <- factor(
  test$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

validation$gender <- factor(
  validation$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

train$field <- factor(
  train$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

test$field <- factor(
  test$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

validation$field <- factor(
  validation$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

train$race.2 <- factor(
  train$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

test$race.2 <- factor(
  test$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

validation$race.2 <- factor(
  validation$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

train$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  train$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)

test$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  test$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)

validation$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  validation$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)
```

# Depression Prediction Models

## Depression Baseline Model

```{r model_04_depression_baseline_model}
phq_baseline_value <- mean(
  train$PHQ
)

phq_baseline_pred <- rep(
  phq_baseline_value,
  nrow(test)
)

phq_baseline_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_baseline_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_baseline_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_baseline_pred
  )
)

phq_baseline_r2 <- 0
```


## Depression Linear Regression

```{r model_05_depression_linear_regression}
phq_lm <- lm(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)

summary(phq_lm)

phq_lm_pred <- predict(
  phq_lm,
  newdata = test
)

phq_lm_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_lm_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_lm_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_lm_pred
  )
)

phq_lm_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_lm_pred
)^2
```

```{r model_06_depression_gender_x_stem_regression}
phq_interaction <- lm(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender * field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)

summary(phq_interaction)

phq_interaction_pred <- predict(

  newdata = test
)

phq_interaction_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_interaction_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_interaction_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_interaction_pred
  )
)

phq_interaction_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_interaction_pred
)^2
```

```{r model_09_prepare_depression_data_for_ridge_and_lass}
)[, -1]

phq_x_test <- model.matrix(

)[, -1]

    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = validation
)[, -1]
```

## Depression Ridge Regression

```{r model_10_depression_ridge_regression}
set.seed(415)

phq_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  x = phq_x_train,
  y = train$PHQ,
  alpha = 0
)

phq_ridge_pred <- predict(
  phq_ridge,
  newx = phq_x_test,
  s = "lambda.min"
)

phq_ridge_pred <- as.numeric(
  phq_ridge_pred
)

phq_ridge_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_ridge_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_ridge_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_ridge_pred
  )
)

phq_ridge_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_ridge_pred
)^2
```

## Depression XGBoost

```{r model_12_depression_xgboost}
phq_xgb_train <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)[, -1]

phq_xgb_test <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = test
)[, -1]

phq_xgb_validation <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = validation
)[, -1]

set.seed(415)

phq_xgb <- xgboost(
  x = phq_xgb_train,
  y = train$PHQ,
  nrounds = 100,
  objective = "reg:squarederror"
)

phq_xgb_pred <- predict(
  phq_xgb,
  phq_xgb_test
)

  )
)

    test$PHQ - phq_xgb_pred
  )
)

phq_xgb_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_xgb_pred
)^2
```


```{r classification_accuracy_function}

# Percentage classified correctly using a total-score cutoff of 10.
classification_accuracy <- function(observed, predicted, outcome) {
  cutoff <- if (outcome == "PHQ") 1 + 10 / 9 else 1 + 10 / 7
  100 * mean((as.numeric(predicted) >= cutoff) == (observed >= cutoff))
}
```

# Depression Test-Set Comparison

```{r model_13_depression_test_set_comparison}
depression_results <- data.frame(

  Model = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Linear Regression",
    "Gender x STEM Regression",
    "Regression Tree",
    "Random Forest",
    "Ridge Regression",
    "LASSO Regression",
    "XGBoost"
  ),

  RMSE = c(
    phq_baseline_rmse,
    phq_lm_rmse,
    phq_interaction_rmse,
    phq_tree_rmse,
    phq_rf_rmse,
    phq_ridge_rmse,
    phq_lasso_rmse,
    phq_xgb_rmse
  ),

  MAE = c(
    phq_baseline_mae,
    phq_lm_mae,
    phq_interaction_mae,
    phq_tree_mae,
    phq_rf_mae,
    phq_ridge_mae,
    phq_lasso_mae,
    phq_xgb_mae
  ),

  R2 = c(
    phq_baseline_r2,
    phq_lm_r2,
    phq_interaction_r2,
    phq_tree_r2,
    phq_rf_r2,
    phq_ridge_r2,
    phq_lasso_r2,
    phq_xgb_r2
  )
)

depression_results$Accuracy <- round(vapply(
  list(phq_baseline_pred, phq_lm_pred, phq_interaction_pred,
       phq_tree_pred, phq_rf_pred, phq_ridge_pred,
       phq_lasso_pred, phq_xgb_pred),
  function(pred) classification_accuracy(test$PHQ, pred, "PHQ"), numeric(1)
), 2)
depression_results <- depression_results[
  order(depression_results$RMSE),
]

depression_results
```

```{r model_16_anxiety_linear_regression}
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +

)
```

```{r model_26_depression_using_student_characteristics_o}
phq_student_pred <- predict(
  phq_student,
  newdata = test
)

phq_student_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(

)

phq_student_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_student_pred
```

# Final Summary


# Paper Figures and Tables


```{r final_paper_export_setup}
final_paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "final_paper")
figure_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "figures")
table_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "tables")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

save_paper_figure <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 5) {
  for (extension in c("png", "pdf")) {
    path <- file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".", extension))
    tryCatch(
      ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
                      dpi = 300, bg = "white"),
      error = function(e) message("Figure not saved: ", path)
    )
  }
}

save_paper_table <- function(tab, filename, digits = 4) {
  csv_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".csv"))
  html_path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".html"))
  tryCatch(
    utils::write.csv(tab, csv_path, row.names = FALSE, na = ""),
    error = function(e) message("Table CSV not saved (file in use or folder blocked): ", csv_path)
  )
  tryCatch(
    writeLines(as.character(knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", digits = digits)), html_path),
    error = function(e) message("Table HTML not saved (file in use or folder blocked): ", html_path)
  )
  invisible(tab)
}
```

## Confusion Matrices

```{r final_paper_confusion_matrices, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
make_confusion <- function(observed, predicted, outcome, cutoff) {
  labels <- c("Below 10", "10 or higher")
  observed_group <- factor(ifelse(observed >= cutoff, labels[2], labels[1]), levels = labels)
  predicted_group <- factor(ifelse(predicted >= cutoff, labels[2], labels[1]), levels = labels)
  tab <- as.data.frame(table(Observed = observed_group, Predicted = predicted_group))
  tab$Outcome <- outcome
  tab
}

confusion_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_confusion(validation$PHQ, phq_interaction_validation_pred, "Depression", 1 + 10 / 9),
  make_confusion(validation$GAD, gad_interaction_validation_pred, "Anxiety", 1 + 10 / 7)
)

confusion_table <- confusion_data %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Predicted, values_from = Freq) %>%
  dplyr::rename(`Predicted below 10` = `Below 10`,
                `Predicted 10 or higher` = `10 or higher`) %>%
  dplyr::select(Outcome, Observed, `Predicted below 10`, `Predicted 10 or higher`)

save_paper_table(confusion_table, "table_07_confusion_matrices")
knitr::kable(confusion_table, caption = "Confusion Matrices")

confusion_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(confusion_data,
    ggplot2::aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed, fill = Freq)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(Freq)), size = 5) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#377EB8", name = "Students") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Outcome, nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Confusion Matrices", x = "Predicted", y = "Observed")
print(confusion_plot)
save_paper_figure(confusion_plot, "figure_07_best_validation_confusion_matrices", 10, 5)
```
